### Historical audit — S0238

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v2_4/audit_sources/raw_failures/scene_rsi_v2_2/r2/fixed_h/H0/fixed_version_test/commons_92056365/trajectory.jsonl` (JSONL lines below).

| Evidence | Observation and limits |
|---|---|
| Goal — line 1, chars [0,5630) | The assigned goal was a separate-mesh reconstruction of an indoor RGB photograph, matching viewpoint, framing, placement and materials, without using the reference as a background or texture. The photograph itself is not visible in this audit. The student's “daylit diner” interpretation is therefore an inferred scene goal, not independently confirmed content. |
| Construction — student response, line 3, chars [0,10535); execute step 1, line 4, chars [0,11191) | The submitted program attempted many objects: tiled floor, ceiling, window frames, exterior scenery, repeated booths, tables, chairs, pendants and plants. It grouped component meshes in assets and rotated chairs for different orientations. These are programmed part relationships and poses, not verified physical connections or reference matches. |
| Materials and view — lines 3–4, same offsets | The code assigned colors, a common roughness, geometric tile and ceiling-board detail, and an almost-invisible-glass treatment; no image texture is specified. It set a camera, three area lights, world illumination, Cycles and 32 samples. Whether the materials, textures, camera, lighting or framing were visually correct is unknown. |
| Validation and outcome — execution result, line 5, chars [0,1131) | Step 1 returned `ok: false` after a 454.56-second timeout, with empty stdout/stderr and `image: null`. No rendered image, successful build, visual inspection, revision or final `DONE` is visible. This is a **technical interruption with unknown scene correctness**, not evidence of an empty patch or an independently established algorithmic failure. The timeout's stage and cause are not reported. |
| Exploration and instruction — session line 2, chars [0,2876); lines 3–5 | One student response and one execution are visible; the session reports zero tool calls. No teacher message, detection, diagnosis, proposed update, receipt or adoption is recorded. There is no evidence of autonomous iterative exploration beyond the initial construction and attempted execution. |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, a detailed procedural scene and explicit camera/light settings do not establish a successful render or visual match; validation requires an actual result. Task-specific hypotheses include whether the dense geometry contributed to the timeout and whether the chosen diner layout or chair connections matched the photograph. Neither is established by this trace. No claim about visual or geometric correctness can be made from the scene name or code alone.
